injuries.longComment: Gray exited to the locker room in the first quarter with a left hand injury. She returned early in the second quarter and briefly had two of her fingers taped before removing the tape, though she later dove for a loose ball and aggravated the injury. Her next chance to play will come in Game 2 on Wednesday.
injuries.shortComment: Gray (hand) exited to the locker room in the second quarter of Sunday's Game 1 against the Liberty and will not return, Alexa Philippou of ESPN.com reports. She'll finish with seven points (1-5 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 4-5 FT), one rebound and one steal in 11 minutes.

injuries.longComment: Villa signed with Atlanta on Sept. 15 but will end the campaign without having seen any game action. She's ineligible to play in the postseason while on a developmental pact.
injuries.shortComment: Villa (coach's decision) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New York.

injuries.longComment: This is a tough blow for a Dream team that is sitting in second place in the Eastern Conference. Jones managed to play in just nine games this campaign, finishing with averages of 8.2 points, 5.6 rebounds and 2.0 assists. Look for the Dream to use a committee approach to soak up those minutes going forward.
injuries.shortComment: Jones will miss the remainder of the season after sustaining a left leg injury against the Sun on Aug. 13, Annie Costabile of The Athletic reports.

injuries.longComment: Rupert signed a multi-year contract with Golden State during the offseason and missed the start of training camp due to an overseas commitment. Her status for the 2026 regular season now appears to be in jeopardy due to her pregnancy. The 24-year-old made 21 regular-season appearances (11 starts) for the Valkyries last year and averaged 9.3 points, 3.9 rebounds and 1.6 assists in 23.1 minutes per game. If Rupert is sidelined in 2026, Janelle Salaun, Kiah Stokes and Laeticia Amihere are candidates to see increased work.
injuries.shortComment: Rupert is pregnant, and the Valkyries have filed for a replacement contract ahead of the 2026 season, Alexa Philippou of ESPN.com reports Thursday.

injuries.longComment: With Loyd joining Dana Evans (knee) and Stephanie Talbot (leg) on the sidelines, Mai Yamamoto and Kierstan Bell could see increased playing time the rest of the way. Loyd's next opportunity to play will come in Wednesday's Game 2.
injuries.shortComment: Loyd suffered a left leg injury in the third quarter of Sunday's Game 1 against the Valkyries and will not return, WNBA reporter Kareem Copeland reports. She'll finish with zero points (0-2 FG, 0-2 3Pt), two rebounds and one assist in 17 minutes.

injuries.longComment: Talbot will miss a second consecutive contest due to a left leg injury, so Jewell Loyd will likely remain in the starting lineup. Cheyenne Parker-Tyus and Brianna Turner could also see increased playing time. Talbot's next chance to play will come in Game 2 on Wednesday.
injuries.shortComment: Talbot (leg) has been ruled out for Game 1 of the semifinals against the Valkyries on Sunday.

injuries.longComment: Evans won't be an option for the first game of the series, but her absence shouldn't impact the rotation too much. She hasn't played since Sep. 22 and is yet to suit up for the Aces in the playoffs.
injuries.shortComment: Evans (knee) is out for Game 1 of the semifinals against the Valkyries on Sunday.

injuries.longComment: It's a big blow for the defending-champion Aces ahead of the postseason. Smith started all 38 of her appearances for Las Vegas, so a spot in the first unit is now open. Brianna Turner appears to the most likely candidate to replace Smith in the starting lineup going forward.
injuries.shortComment: The Aces announced Thursday that Smith will be sidelined for the rest of the season after suffering a non-contact left leg injury during Sunday's game versus the Tempo, per Chelsea Leite of TSN.

injuries.longComment: Balogun remains away from the Liberty for the regular-season finale Wednesday. It's unknown if she'll report to the club at any point this postseason.
injuries.shortComment: Balogun (not with team) is out for Wednesday's game against the Dream.
